rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone with long experience in a particular activity.

example.english: He is a veteran at the company and is great at handling customer complaints.
example.traditional: 佢係公司入面嘅老手，處理客人投訴好有一手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 lou5 sau2 cyu2 lei5 haak3 jan4 tau4 sou3 hou2 jau5 jat1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a former member of the armed forces when the emphasis is on having served in the military.

example.english: That veteran opened a snack shop after leaving the military.
example.traditional: 嗰位退伍軍人退役之後，開咗間小食店。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 teoi3 ng5 gwan1 jan4 teoi3 jik6 zi1 hau6 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 siu2 sik6 dim3

rows.note: Use this for an old or long-serving soldier, especially when highlighting military experience rather than simply former service.

example.english: This veteran spent decades on the battlefield and is still going strong.
example.traditional: 呢位老兵喺戰場上打滾咗幾十年，仲係咁精神。
example.jyutping: ne1 wai6 lou5 bing1 hai2 zin3 coeng4 soeng6 daa2 gwan2 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 zung6 hai6 gam3 zing1 san4
